The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Tough. Efficient. And built to keep you moving forward.

Whether you’re a homeowner with acreage or a part-time professional landscaper, the Ferris 300S delivers reliable performance and operator-focused comfort at a value that makes sense. With its commercial-inspired design, the 300S is ready to tackle demanding tasks with precision and ease.

The new Ferris 300S-52, B25 combines power, durability, and smooth operation with a 52” fabricated deck, commercial-grade features, and a 25 HP Briggs & Stratton® engine. Designed for productivity without sacrificing ride quality, this mower is a standout performer in its class.

Features may include:

Commercial-Grade Power
Equipped with a 25 HP Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series 8240 PXi V-Twin engine for reliable, consistent performance.

Comfort Ride Suspension
Rear coil-over shocks help smooth out rough terrain and reduce operator fatigue.

Fabricated Cutting Deck
A rugged 52″ iCD™ Cutting System improves airflow and cut quality for a crisp, even finish.

Hydro-Gear® Transaxles
Hydro-Gear® ZT-2800® drive system delivers responsive control and dependable performance.

Convenient Cut Height Adjustment
Quick-adjust lever offers height-of-cut settings from 1.5” – 4.5” in 1/4” increments.

Operator-Centered Design
High-back seat with armrests, ergonomic controls, and wide foot platform enhance operator comfort and usability.

Fuel Capacity
A 5.5-gallon fuel tank supports extended operation with fewer refueling breaks.

Built for Versatility
A great fit for property owners and light commercial users looking for a mower that can handle more.
